title: Aethrimor Digital card game updates
author: jawanaman
selftext: Hey everyone. I've been updating my game, but honestly am reaching a point where I'm needing feedback on how to make the game better.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
Okay. 

Attempted to start a game. 

  
Game locked me into a not-cutscene where nothing happened other than character appearing in different locations (...and, bizarrely, I could rotate the camera during this horrible not-cutscene I was forced to watch for God knows what reason). After about a minute of this, I quit. 

  
Feedback: I don't think it is enjoyable to sit through a not-cutscene where nothing happens. Maybe go to gameplay instead of that?

replies.author: jawanaman
replies.body: Wait. That's happening at the start for you? Is this in adventure mode?  The game is supposed to open to the main menu for everyone and you can either choose a duel or adventure mode

replies.author: jawanaman
replies.body: That's odd. Would you mind testing the multiplayer out with me? I've never had anyone test it before
